title: Recurring payments
intro: Bills that come back on their own: rent, phone, gym, subscriptions. The Month view counts what they still take this month.

error.title: Recurring payments did not load
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No recurring payments yet
empty.body: Detection needs about three payments to the same merchant. Import your bank’s CSV, or add one by hand.

sheet.payeeHint: As it shows on your bank statement.
sheet.linkSuggestions: Is it one of these? Link it so its payments count
sheet.linked: Linked to {payee}: its payments count as paid

toast.found: {count, plural, =0 {No new recurring payments} one {Found # recurring payment} other {Found # recurring payments}}
toast.paused: {payee} paused: it no longer counts as committed
toast.dismissed: {payee} dismissed: detection will not bring it back

deleteSheet.title: Delete {payee}?
deleteSheet.body: It stops counting as committed. Its payments stay in your spending.
deleteSheet.bodyDetected: It stops counting as committed. Detection may find it again; to keep it away, choose Not a bill instead.
